question: Who led India’s official delegation to the inauguration ceremony of Pope Leo XIV in Vatican City?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harivansh Narayan Singh​.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Harivansh, the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha, led India’s official delegation to the inauguration ceremony of Pope Leo XIV in Vatican City.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harivansh, the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha, led the official Indian delegation to the inauguration of Pope Leo XIV in Vatican City.**
 
• Nagaland Deputy Chief Minister, Yanthungo Patton, was also part of the delegation attending the event.
 
• The Indian delegation had a personal audience with Pope Leo XIV after the ceremony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Pope Leo XIV__

 __
 
• The Pope is the head of the Roman Catholic Church and plays a significant role in global religious and political affairs.
 
 
 
• Rajya Sabha__
 __
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Parliament of India, with members elected indirectly.
 
 
 
• Vatican City__
 
 
• The Vatican City is an independent city-state enclaved within Rome, serving as the headquarters of the Roman Catholic Church.
